p1.p: Can I post to my clients' accounts without their passwords?
p1.r: Yes. Each client connects their networks to their brand in Clipfine once, and your team schedules from there. Nobody on your team needs the password.

p2.p: What if the client has to approve first?
p2.r: Turn on review before publishing for their brand. What your team schedules stays To review until the client approves it or asks for changes.

p3.p: Can I download the MP4 for other networks?
p3.r: Yes. Every finished clip downloads as an MP4, ready for LinkedIn, X or wherever the client needs it.
